parts.text: A dance club has 90 members. Here is some information about types of dancing members like. 50 like Ballroom ( B ) 37 like Latin ( L ) 47 like Modern ( M ) 18 like Ballroom and Latin 15 like Ballroom and Modern 22 like Latin and Modern 8 like Ballroom, Latin and Modern

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Complete the Venn diagram. B L M 10 8 U [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Write down the number of members who do not like any of these three types of dancing. .................................................... [1]

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Two of the 90 members are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both like Ballroom and Latin but not Modern. .................................................... [2]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) Two of the members who like Ballroom are chosen. Find the probability that one of these members likes Latin but not Modern and the other likes Modern but not Latin. .................................................... [3]
